import sys, json, argparse, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

r=Robot()
spec=r.spec(); DT=spec['control_dt']; cams=list(spec['cameras'])

def observe(tag):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True)
    root=Path('/app/output')/tag; root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    (root/'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta,indent=2))
    for cam in cams:
        Image.fromarray(obs.last[cam]).save(root/f'{cam}.png')
        if cam in obs.depth: np.save(root/f'{cam}_depth.npy',obs.depth[cam])
    return obs

def state(obs):
    p=obs.meta['proprio']['now']; return np.array(p[:3]), np.array(p[4:7]), p[3]

def command_to(target_tcp, grip, tag, settle=8):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=cams)
    tcp,mocap,opening=state(obs)
    target_tcp=np.array(target_tcp,float)
    delta=target_tcp-tcp
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta))/.006)))
    n=min(n,200)
    action=np.clip(delta/(n*.01),-.75,.75)
    actions=np.tile(np.r_[action,grip],(n,1))
    if settle: actions=np.r_[actions,np.tile([0,0,0,grip],(settle,1))]
    res=r.submit('ee_delta',actions,dt=DT,cameras=cams,video='none',include_depth=True,note=tag)
    print(tag,'before',tcp,mocap,opening,'request',target_tcp,'actions',n,'after',res.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now',None),'steps',res.meta['control_steps'],flush=True)
    observe(tag)

if __name__=='__main__':
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('stage'); args=ap.parse_args()
    if args.stage=='initial': observe('initial')
    elif args.stage=='hover': command_to([.125,.651,.090],-1,'hover')
    elif args.stage=='lower': command_to([.125,.651,.030],-1,'lower',settle=5)
    elif args.stage=='close': command_to([.125,.651,.030],1,'close',settle=35)
    elif args.stage=='lift': command_to([.125,.651,.145],1,'lift',settle=10)
PY
